task.description:
rework for FAIL handoffs/M1CODE-20261119-01/step-01b-code-design-validator.json, gate pass 1 of 3 — WF-02, step 1 (rework), CODE-DESIGNER, run M1CODE-20261119-01 (task M1.4 of PUBLIC-V1: REQ-111, REQ-112). Close each remark below in docs/design/REQ-111-112-public-landing.md (or keep the text and say why in result.issues with evidence), keep what the gate did not question, re-run on a clean copy the trials a change touches, and record them. The readings of decisions/0124, Addition of 2026-11-19 (О13: the build starts from the tag base/M1CODE-20261119-01-build, the merge 2144f2a of main d87b3d1, and every command naming base/<RUN-ID> reads that tag for this run; О14: one narrow IB-1 row for a .d.ts whose .js twin is an entry of app/vendored.json, with its damaged copies), bind the fix of F1.

Remarks (gate pass 1, step 01b):
- F1 [high] The replacement table, the guard facts and the counts were measured at the tag only, while the fix round of the app skeleton lands first. (a) The fix round's IB-1 makes every non-.js file under app/server, app/api, app/worker red, so server/vendor/picker-engine.d.ts (4.8, section 3, B1) is red and row 5 «no edit» is wrong; a plain move with rootDirs leaves tsc at 50 errors. (b) The fix round already has a test NPM-6 (the skip/todo/only grep); the design's new e2e guard is also NPM-6 and its counts (unit 69 new, 114) are the tag's. (c) REQ-111 criterion 16 and REQ-112 criterion 10 read git diff --stat base/M1CODE-20261119-01 -- app/test tools/test, which after the merge also lists the fix round's files; the line numbers of rows 1, 2, 5 and 9–12 move (RED.length 53 → 161). Fix: re-measure against the tree the build starts from with a «was → became» row for every changed guard; choose and measure the declaration's place or form (or the narrow row); rename the guard and recount sections 0, 10, 19; say how the two diffs tell this run's changes from the fix round's.
- F2 [medium] The public set is tested only for what it leaves out. stripRegions does not say a region ends at its nearest end marker; a greedy cut (V01) passes every check while index.html loses </main>, the footer, the AI disclosure and the nav links. Fix: the shortest match in 4.11 and V01 in section 13; positive checks of the public set (each changed page equals its source with exactly the region lines removed; the rules of PP-2…PP-4 on the output: the test-mode line and the AI disclosure with their texts, every href and src naming a file of the public set); LD-9 also sees the scene and caption on index, how, demo and «Описать идею» opening /how.html#describe-idea; mutants for the greedy cut and a region enclosing #ai-disclosure.
- F3 [low] Row REQ-112/9 and OP-6 count one list two ways; one wording: ten planted forms (six calls, three strings, one template literal), seven green twins.
- F4 [low] No E-row and no LD-7 case names «no connection» (a request that fails at once) with the look's offline message; E7 (no script) is mapped to UAT criterion 13, which does not name it. Fix: the network-error case in E2 and an LD-7 case (a route that aborts); E7 to DESIGN-QA's states or an e2e case with script off.
- F5 [low] The team avatars have no draw or redraw rule. Fix: drawn at load and after each theme change from the palette read once per change; name the check.
- F6 [low] decisions/0124 О7 says the first step of the e2e job prints the Chrome version and the path it uses; the design's step prints only the version, after the three common steps. Fix: print the path too, or record that the logged command line is the path.
- F7 [low] RB-1 of runbooks.test.js reads app/README.md (a lowercase vercel outside npx vercel@<pin> is red); B3 rewrites its Deploy part and B3's own check may not include the unit step. Fix: name RB-1 among B3's checks and include test:unit.
- F8 [low] PB-4 runs the open build in place on the project's real app/public and relies on the refusal it tests (VB-4 has the same shape). Fix: run it on a copy inside a temporary git tree made by the test, or record why the real tree is needed.
- F9 [low] el() refuses style and on… attribute names, but no test pins it. Fix: a unit case (style and onclick refused, data-x allowed), for TEST-DESIGNER.
- F10 [low] REQ-108 criterion 2 compares «# tests N» with the skeleton design's catalogue; this run and the fix round change the counts. Fix: add REQ-108 criterion 2's count reference to the list for ORCH and M1AMEND, or say how its re-check reads the counts at the released commit.

Rules (docs/workflows/handoffs.md, «Common rules for all roles»): write only the design and this handoff; trials only in a fresh git clone outside the project; no commit, push, tag, stash, reset, checkout, clean or branch switch in the project or any copy; no path of the computer in a Sai file; result.changes holds the table «what was fixed, where» by remark; new questions only ORCH can answer go in result.issues with a default. Before close: cd tools && npm run handoffs-check and npm run traces.
acceptance_criteria: Every remark F1–F10 is closed in the design, or kept with the reason and evidence in result.issues
The trials a change touches are re-run on a fresh clone of base/M1CODE-20261119-01-build outside the project and recorded with command and output
result.changes holds the table «what was fixed, where» by remark (docs/workflows/handoffs.md, «Rework steps and re-runs»)
